archimate:Outcome.name: Public Dashboards Published on Schedule
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
An accountability and transparency outcome achieved by regularly releasing updated public health and financial data to the general public via accessible digital interfaces at predetermined intervals. This predictable release schedule ensures that critical communication channels remain active, reliable, and independent of external political or administrative delays.
Its primary purpose is to maintain public trust by keeping government operations fully visible and auditable. Additionally, it empowers communities, researchers, and stakeholders with the timely, accurate information needed to evaluate public health performance and fiscal spending.
Example: On the first day of every month, a municipal health department automatically refreshes its online data portal to display the latest vaccine distribution rates and program expenditures, allowing local citizens and journalists to track exactly how tax dollars are impacting community health.
